description: For the actual certified checker presenting an arithmetic theory \(T\supseteq Q\), there is a total computable function \(f(p,n)\) such that every accepted proof certificate \(p\) of code \(n\) is transformed into an accepted certificate \(f(p,n)\) of \(\operatorname{Prov}_T(\overline n)\). The function also terminates on invalid inputs; no primitive-recursive bound is asserted.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FormalizedProvability.computable_introspection_compiler (E : ℕ → ℕ → Bool)
  (hE : Primrec₂ E)
  (hQ :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.Q ⊆
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.theory
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.arithmeticSignature E) :
  ∃ f,
    Computable f ∧
      ∀ (p n : ℕ),
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.certificateCheck
              Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.arithmeticSignature E p n =
            true →
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.certificateCheck
              Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.arithmeticSignature E (f (p, n))
              (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FormalizedProvability.provabilityCode
                (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FormalizedProvability.certificateRepresentation E hE) n) =
            true
